slots.name: steps
slots.about: copied into state: id (1 up, the step order), ask (the question), back (days into the past a date may go, 0 = not before today), ahead (days into the future, 0 = not after today), optional (true when it may be skipped)

slots.name: step_line
slots.about: the counter over the bar; may read cur and total

slots.name: hint_line
slots.about: the line under the question; may read cur_optional

slots.name: early_error
slots.about: the field's error when the date is further back than the step allows; may read cur_back

slots.name: late_error
slots.about: the field's error when the date is further ahead than the step allows; may read cur_ahead

slots.name: next_word
slots.about: the forward button's words before the last step

slots.name: finish_word
slots.about: the forward button's words on the last step

slots.name: done_line
slots.about: the line under it; may read answered, skipped and total

slots.name: set_date
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: the picked date, answering the shown step

slots.name: clear
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: takes back the answer on an optional step

slots.name: prev
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: one step back

slots.name: next
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: one step on, or finish on the last; waits for a fitting date unless the step is optional

slots.name: edit
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: back to the last step from the finished state

empty.shows: empty_note only; no steps and no buttons

attention.shows: the field's error in words, saying how far back or ahead the step allows, and a dim forward button

fallback.shows: done_title, done_line with answered and skipped counts, and the edit button

labels.next_btn: finish_word on the last step, next_word before

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops shrink, smooth, swap and rise
accessibility.not_colour_alone: an unpicked day is dimmed and the hint asks for one; an unfit date is said in words under the field; the counter says the step in words as well as the bar
